Introduction

Lim Seulong is a South Korean singer, actor, and entertainer currently under Zenith CNM. He debuted in 2008 as the main vocalist of the ballad boy group 2AM under JYP Entertainment. Known for his warm vocal tone and emotional delivery, Seulong has also pursued a successful solo career and built a strong acting portfolio across television and film. Over the years, he has been signed to multiple agencies including SidusHQ and Jellyfish Entertainment, and was previously affiliated with Wake One as both an artist and music advisor. In 2025, he signed with Zenith CNM to continue his activities in both music and acting.
